dataset_spec.name: uci_spectf
dataset_spec.description: UCI SPECTF Heart (267 patients, 44 features). Perfusion counts in 22 myocardial regions of interest at rest and under stress, summarising cardiac SPECT images; binary normal vs abnormal study as judged by cardiologists.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult undergoing myocardial perfusion imaging with cardiac single-photon emission computed tomography (SPECT), acquired at rest and after stress. The observations are the integer perfusion counts (0-100 scale, higher means better tracer uptake) in each of 22 regions of interest of the left ventricle, listed as rest and stress pairs.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Myocardial perfusion counts per region of interest (ROI), rest and stress (0-100 scale):

abnormal.question: Based on these rest and stress perfusion counts, did the cardiologists read this patient's myocardial perfusion SPECT study as abnormal?
